description: Rich content popup anchored to a trigger element with configurable position (Top, Bottom, Left, Right), optional arrow, and controlled/uncontrolled open state. Closes on Escape key.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: Title of the sheet header when the body presents as a bottom sheet on a narrow viewport. Falls back to AriaLabel and then to a localized generic "Menu", so the sheet dialog is always named. The popover does not render it (since 2.9.1).

parameters.name: MobilePresentation
parameters.description: How the body presents on a narrow viewport. Auto follows the viewport scope: a content-height bottom sheet on mobile, the anchored popover otherwise. A forced value renders without measuring (since 2.9.1).

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: The layout the body presentation resolves from. Auto follows the viewport scope; a forced value never measures, so a test can render a mode without a DOM (since 2.9.1).

parameters.name: InitialMode
parameters.description: The layout rendered before the first measurement. Desktop unless the host says otherwise (since 2.9.1).

parameters.name: ResolvedLayoutChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the resolved layout changes (the initial value is not a change). Never pair with LayoutMode — a two-way bind would pin the mode (since 2.9.1).
